Newton's Laws and Application of Newton'.net force: Net force (Newton's second law): F_net = ma.
Newton's Laws and Application of Newton'.maximum static frictional force: Maximum static frictional force: f_s_max = μ_s N.
Newton's Laws and Application of Newton'.kinetic frictional force: Kinetic frictional force: f_k = μ_k N.
Newton's Laws and Application of Newton'.newtons law of universal gravitation: Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation: F = G m1 m2 / r².

Momentum and Impulse.change in momentum: Change in momentum: Δp = mv_f - mv_i.
Momentum and Impulse.newtons second law in terms of momentum: Newton's second law in terms of momentum: F_net = Δp / Δt.
Momentum and Impulse.elastic collision:
Elastic collision: both momentum and kinetic energy are conserved.
Σp_i = Σp_f  →  m₁v₁ᵢ + m₂v₂ᵢ = m₁v₁f + m₂v₂f
ΣK_i = ΣK_f  →  ½m₁v₁ᵢ² + ½m₂v₂ᵢ² = ½m₁v₁f² + ½m₂v₂f²
Relative velocity (1D elastic): v₁ᵢ - v₂ᵢ = -(v₁f - v₂f).
Momentum and Impulse.inelastic collision:
Inelastic collision: momentum is conserved, kinetic energy is NOT conserved (some is lost to heat, sound, deformation).
Σp_i = Σp_f  →  m₁v₁ᵢ + m₂v₂ᵢ = m₁v₁f + m₂v₂f
ΔK = K_f - K_i < 0 (energy lost).
Momentum and Impulse.perfectly inelastic collision:
Perfectly inelastic collision: the objects stick together after the collision.
Σp_i = Σp_f  →  m₁v₁ᵢ + m₂v₂ᵢ = (m₁ + m₂) v_f.

Vertical Projectile Motion in One Dimens.equations of motion:
Equations of motion (vertical projectile motion, 1D):
1) v_f = v_i + aΔt
2) Δx = v_i Δt + ½ a Δt²   (also Δy)
3) v_f² = v_i² + 2aΔx   (also 2aΔy)
4) Δx = ((v_i + v_f) / 2) Δt   (also Δy)
where a = g = 9.8 m·s⁻² downward for free fall.

Work, Energy and Power.work: Work done by a constant force: W = F Δx cos θ.
Work, Energy and Power.work energy theorem: Work-energy theorem: W_net = ΔK = K_f - K_i.
Work, Energy and Power.gravitational potential energy: Gravitational potential energy: U = mgh (or E_p = mgh).
Work, Energy and Power.work done by non conservative forces: Work done by non-conservative forces: W_nc = ΔK + ΔU (or ΔE_k + ΔE_p).
Work, Energy and Power.power: Power as rate of work done: P = W / Δt.
Work, Energy and Power.average power: Average power at constant speed: P_ave = F v_ave.

Doppler Effect.doppler effect: Doppler effect for sound: f_L = ((v ± v_L) / (v ± v_s)) f_s.

Electrostatics.coulombs law: Coulomb's law: F = k Q1 Q2 / r².
Electrostatics.electric field: Electric field at a point: E = F / q.
Electrostatics.electric field due to a point charge: Electric field due to a point charge: E = k Q / r².
Electrostatics.number of charges: Number of charges: n = Q / e (or n = Q / q_e).

Electric Circuits.ohms law: Ohm's law / resistance: R = V / I.
Electric Circuits.resistance: Ohm's law / resistance: R = V / I.
Electric Circuits.emf with internal resistance: emf (load + internal): ε = V_load + V_internal resistance (or ε = IR_ext + Ir).
Electric Circuits.electrical energy: Electrical energy: W = V I Δt.

Electrodynamics.average power ac: Average power for a purely resistive AC circuit: P_ave = I_rms V_rms = ½ I_max V_max.

Optical Phenomena and Properties of Mate.energy of a photon: Energy of a photon: E = hf (or E = hc / λ).
Optical Phenomena and Properties of Mate.maximum kinetic energy of photoelectrons: Maximum kinetic energy of emitted photoelectrons: E_k(max) = ½ m v_max².

Quantitative Aspects of Chemical Change.number of moles: Number of moles: n = m / M.
Quantitative Aspects of Chemical Change.number of moles from particles: Number of moles: n = N / N_A.
Quantitative Aspects of Chemical Change.molar concentration: Molar concentration: c = n / V (or c = m / (M V)).
Quantitative Aspects of Chemical Change.moles of gas: Number of moles of gas: n = V / V_m.
Quantitative Aspects of Chemical Change.titration stoichiometry: Titration stoichiometry: c_a V_a / n_a = c_b V_b / n_b.

Acids and Bases.ion product of water: Ion product of water: Kw = [H3O⁺][OH⁻] = 1 × 10⁻¹⁴ at 298 K.

Electrochemical Reactions.standard cell potential: Standard cell potential: E°_cell = E°_cathode - E°_anode.

Simple Interest.simple interest amount: Simple interest amount: A = P(1 + in).

Compound Interest.compound growth time: Compound-growth time: n = log(A/P) / log(1 + i).

Annuities.future value of annuity: Future value of annuity: FV = X ((1 + i)^n - 1) / i.
Annuities.present value of annuity: Present value of annuity: PV = X (1 - (1 + i)^(-n)) / i.
Annuities.sinking fund payment: Sinking fund payment: X = FV · i / ((1 + i)^n - 1).

Loans.loan repayment: Loan repayment: X = PV · i / (1 - (1 + i)^(-n)).
Loans.outstanding balance: Outstanding balance: B = PV(1 + i)^k - X ((1 + i)^k - 1) / i.

Arithmetic Sequences.arithmetic sum: Arithmetic sum: S_n = (n / 2)[2a + (n - 1)d]  OR  S_n = (n / 2)(a + T_n).

Geometric Sequences.geometric nth term: Geometric nth term: T_n = a r^(n - 1).
Geometric Sequences.geometric sum: Geometric sum: S_n = a(1 - r^n) / (1 - r).
Geometric Sequences.infinite geometric sum: Infinite geometric sum: S_∞ = a / (1 - r).
Geometric Sequences.geometric n: Geometric n: n = 1 + log(T_n / a) / log r.

Exponential and Logarithmic.transformed exponential: Transformed exponential: y = ab^(x - p) + q.
Exponential and Logarithmic.exponential log relationship: Exponential/log relationship: b^x = y ⟺ x = log_b y.
Exponential and Logarithmic.product log law: Product log law: log_b(MN) = log_b M + log_b N.
Exponential and Logarithmic.quotient log law: Quotient log law: log_b(M/N) = log_b M - log_b N.
Exponential and Logarithmic.power log law: Power log law: log_b(M^n) = n log_b M.
Exponential and Logarithmic.change of base: Change of base: log_b M = log M / log b.

Measures of Dispersion.alternative variance: Alternative variance: σ² = Σx² / n - x̄².

Parallel, Perpendicular and Angles.angle between lines: Angle between lines: tan θ = |(m_2 - m_1) / (1 + m_1 m_2)|.

Circles.circle at origin: Circle at origin: x² + y² = r².

Identities.tan identity: Tan identity: tan θ = sin θ / cos θ.

Compound Angle Formulae.sine compound: Sine compound: sin(A ± B) = sin A cos B ± cos A sin B.
Compound Angle Formulae.cos compound: Cos compound: cos(A ± B) = cos A cos B ∓ sin A sin B.
Compound Angle Formulae.tan compound: Tan compound: tan(A ± B) = (tan A ± tan B) / (1 ∓ tan A tan B).

Double Angle Formulae.double sine: Double sine: sin 2A = 2 sin A cos A.
Double Angle Formulae.double cosine: Double cosine: cos 2A = cos²A - sin²A  OR  cos 2A = 2 cos²A - 1  OR  cos 2A = 1 - 2 sin²A.
Double Angle Formulae.double tangent: Double tangent: tan 2A = 2 tan A / (1 - tan²A).

Triangles.sine rule: Sine rule: a / sin A = b / sin B = c / sin C.
Triangles.cosine rule: Cosine rule: a² = b² + c² - 2bc cos A.
Triangles.triangle area: Triangle area: A = ½ ab sin C.

Lines and Angles.exterior angle: Exterior angle: Sum of opposite interior angles.

Triangles.isosceles triangle: Isosceles triangle: Equal sides ⇒ equal opposite angles.
Triangles.similar sides: Similar sides: a / d = b / e = c / f.

Circle Geometry.tangents from same point: Tangents from same point: PA = PB.
Circle Geometry.tangent chord: Tangent-chord: Angle tangent/chord = angle opposite segment.
